Name: Shop Anywhere for Android
Author: kazutopi1
Description:
This mod adds a new item available at Pierre’s that allows the player to access various Shops and Menus from any location. The item can be used by tapping the virtual Button B(Virtual Joypad), by tapping where the player is standing in(Tap to Move), or by pressing Q using virtual keyboards, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39436]So Many Toolbars[/url] built in keys.

[url=https://github.com/kazutopi1/ShopAnywhereAndroid]Source Code[/url]
